todos.title: Jailbreak Kindle Voyage (WatchThis legacy + custom hotfix bin)
todos.details: WatchThis release tree + custom hotfix (SP01, SHA 2102e30f…) installed 21.09.2026. ROM stays read-only; exec from FAT not possible (drives T04). No 5.14+ update (breaks chain).
todos.verification: hotfix bin on card, .boot + refresh.sh run after reboot, capability est. 100% (MRPI logs)

todos.details: BusyBox wget from device to the n8n webhook over LAN; binary response readable on card.
todos.verification: wget PoC green, HTTP 200 + PNG bytes on card

todos.title: Static ARM Go binary dash (cross-compiled, CGO off)
todos.details: Static linux/arm binary, runs on kernel 3.0.35. Source on ANOTHER machine (/Users/private/kindle-dash), not in repo — see T11.

todos.title: Exec-from-FAT problem: stage to /tmp, re-stage on size change
todos.details: refresh.sh v4: size check → re-stage dash to /tmp (tmpfs) → run. Makes future dash replacements hot-swappable without reboot choreography.
todos.verification: refresh.sh v4 (2,720 B, SHA b1c06190…) live on card, cycles clean in refresh.log

todos.title: Identify eips -g as render path + prove the two hard requirements
todos.details: eips -b = NO-OP on KV. eips -g: (1) IHDR color type MUST be 0 (grayscale), (2) exactly 1 IDAT (first chunk read, rest dropped → zoomed crop). Supersedes the afternoon 'accepts 8-bit RGB' belief via controlled 32×32 experiment.
todos.verification: controlled 8×8/32×32 + 3,697 B full-frame tests pixel-exact; broken cases preserved (dashboard-real.png.bak, webhook captures)

todos.title: v1 unattended refresh loop (wget + eips, ~1 min cycle)
todos.details: First live loop; worked unattended. Superseded by v3/v4 (kept for history).
todos.verification: ran unattended on device (superseded, not a failure)

todos.title: n8n code node t180 (gold code, sandbox-verified byte-exact)
todos.details: t180-n8n.js (14,565 B, SHA 76f8f8b2…) implements transpose+180° in the code node; verified byte-exact vs golden in the n8n sandbox. NEVER deployed (API key 401 → T19). Orientation therefore still handled on device side.
todos.verification: 28,052,160-pixel comparison PASS in sandbox; deploy blocked (T19)

todos.title: Working-buffer analysis (fb0 dump, plane/stride, 16 px drift)
todos.details: fb0 = 2 planes (3,104,512 B = 1072×2896, 16-bit LE); pre-FLASH dump: 4 values {0x3de, 0x3c0, 0x1e, 0x0}; agreement ~0.86; ~16 px/row drift (1072 vs 1088 stride); shear simulation gives no improvement → NO shear in production path.
todos.verification: eips -k dump analysis (documented in docs/03); decision: go through eips, no offset hacks

todos.title: v3 Mac-proxy architecture + bistable dashboard.png visible
todos.details: Mac proxy served the image; eips -g rendered it each cycle. Kept the Mac in the loop permanently → superseded by final architecture (T12-T17). Currently visible image is the bistable remainder of this phase.
todos.verification: user-visible dashboard (superseded by design, not by failure)

todos.title: Final architecture decision: device-side grayscale + single-IDAT + eips
todos.details: dash = fetch + Go decode + Floyd-Steinberg + saveKindlePNG → /mnt/us/dashboard.png; display = exec eips -g (30 s), download 300 s. n8n stays RGB (converted on device).
todos.verification: decided 24.09 after T08 working-buffer analysis; plan fixed at I10 steps 1-7

todos.title: Implement saveKindlePNG in convert.go (filter-0 rows → ONE zlib stream → 1 IDAT, color type 0)
todos.details: Go counterpart of the Python recipe: manual PNG (IHDR bd=8 ct=0 interlace=0, one IDAT via compress/zlib over all filter-0 rows, CRC32 IEEE). NOT image/png (blocks at ~32 KB → 48 IDAT). Self-test: write test PNG, validate with the shell validator in docs/03.

todos.title: main.go get(): remove all rotation/mirror code (image arrives pre-oriented from n8n)
todos.details: Keep: fetch, decode, grayscale, downscale, quantize. Drop: rotation/mirror handling of the input (DASH_FLIPX/DASH_FLIPY become obsolete). Output geometry 1072×1448.

todos.title: fb_linux.go display(): replace mmap with exec /usr/sbin/eips -g <file> -x 0 -y 0
todos.details: RISK: static binary may lack permission to exec eips (AppArmor/seccomp). Fallback if rc!=0 persists: dash stops at 'write PNG only' and refresh.sh itself calls eips afterwards. Log the exec result to diag.log either way.

todos.title: fb_stub.go: PGM output for development on the Mac
todos.details: Build tag for non-linux: render path writes a PGM the developer can inspect; removes dead env-var branches (DASH_FLIPX/Y).

todos.details: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm GOARM=7 go build -ldflags="-s". Go 1.24+ FORBIDDEN (needs Linux ≥3.2; device 3.0.35). Compare size to 6.29 MB; on success replace artifacts/binaries/dash + update SHA in docs/05.
